title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: cellProbeModel
text:
cell probe model
cell probe model
(definition)
Definition:
A
model of computation
where the cost of a computation is measured by the total number of memory accesses to a random access memory with ⌈log n⌉ bits cell size.  All other computations are not counted and are considered to be free.
See also
random access machine
,
pointer machine
,
Turing machine
,
big-O notation
.
